mapper.select: /* commoncode-mapper.xml id="selectAgeAmtView" 연령별 기준금액 초과계약 연령별 기준금액설정 조회 */ SELECT tb2.cd_vl AS exceeded_prem_amt20 , tb3.cd_vl AS exceeded_prem_amt30 , tb4.cd_vl AS exceeded_prem_amt40 , tb5.cd_vl AS exceeded_prem_amt50 , tb6.cd_vl AS exceeded_prem_amt60 FROM (SELECT 1) tb1 LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT * FROM tbcm_common_code WHERE mb_id = #{mb_id} AND grp_cmm_cd = 'EXCEEDED_PREM_AMT20') tb2 ON 1 = 1 LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT * FROM tbcm_common_code WHERE mb_id = #{mb_id} AND grp_cmm_cd = 'EXCEEDED_PREM_AMT30') tb3 ON 1 = 1 LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT * FROM tbcm_common_code WHERE mb_id = #{mb_id} AND grp_cmm_cd = 'EXCEEDED_PREM_AMT40') tb4 ON 1 = 1 LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT * FROM tbcm_common_code WHERE mb_id = #{mb_id} AND grp_cmm_cd = 'EXCEEDED_PREM_AMT50') tb5 ON 1 = 1 LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT * FROM tbcm_common_code WHERE mb_id = #{mb_id} AND grp_cmm_cd = 'EXCEEDED_PREM_AMT60') tb6 ON 1 = 1
